LanguageData.ESCP_Vampire_TurnedText:
The disease has run its course, and {0} has become a vampire.
They will need to feed on sleeping or helpless people to keep the thirst down, and daylight will hurt them. A filled black soul gem can be used in a ritual to cure them.
LanguageData.ESCP_Vampire_CannotFeed: Can only feed on a person who is asleep, downed, or a prisoner.
LanguageData.ESCP_Vampire_CannotTurn: Can only turn a person who is asleep.
